claim_updates.reason: Decompression correctness established within frozen scope: iterative decompression (brotli->gzip->identity, max_depth=5) produces byte-identical output to ground-truth uncompressed body for all 4 auth states across 3 content types and 3 chunk configurations (360/360 passes, 0 silent fallbacks, 0 errors). V1/V2 degeneracy from parent resolved. However, claim ceiling is bounded to localhost mock server with brotli quality 6, 1KB payloads, chunk_size=32/1024, Python 3.12.14 brotli 1.2.0, buffered reverse proxy. Real CDN infrastructure (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai) is the sole remaining product-readiness blocker. Larger payloads (10KB/100KB), gzip multi-chunk, brotli quality variation (4-8), streaming partial-frame forwarding, and production OAuth/OIDC middleware remain untested.

product_action: C-MEAS-VALID decompression-correctness blocker removed for localhost mock scope.
